newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: De Boer, Unigro see 10 pct profit growth long-term.
newsitem.headline: De Boer, Unigro see 10 pct profit growth long-term.

text.p: AMSTERDAM, May 13 (Reuter) Supermarkets group De Boer Winkelbedrijven and unlisted wholesaler Unigro said on Tuesday they targeted long-term net profit growth of at least 10 percent.

"Taking into account the rate at which the envisaged improved returns and cost savings can be realised, the management of De Boer Winkelbedrijven and Unigro are targeting annual growth in net profits of at least 10 percent on average in the years after 1997," the two said in a statement.
They said the combine posted a pro-forma 1996 net profit of 90.1 million guilders and saw a 'clear' rise in 1997.

The companies said earlier their merged combine, set to become the second-largest player in the Dutch grocery sector with annual turnover of more than six billion guilders, would generate important synergy benefits.
